text_md:
Table 4. Clinical Trials of Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis

| Trial         | Study Population                                                                                                              | Location                                                        | Intervention                                                   | Outcome                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Comments                                                                                                                                |
|---------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| TDF2          | 1,219 sexually active adults; 55% male; 45% female; 94% unmarried; approximately 90% 21-29 aged                               | Botswana                                                        | Daily oral TDFI FTC                                            | 63% protection                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | >309 did not complete study; cannot draw definitive conclusions for women and men separately:                                           |
| PIP           | 4,758 serodiscordant heterosexual couples; 38% HIV-negative female; 68% HIV-negative male partner; 98% married; median age 33 | Botswana, Rwanda, South Africa; Tanzania; Uganda; Zambia Kenya; | Daily oral TDF or TDFIFTC                                      | 67% protection with TDF alone; 75% protection with TDFIFTC                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Serodiscordant couples may be a distinct; unique population:                                                                            |
| FEM-PrEP      | 1,951 heterosexual women aged 18-35 at high risk of infection                                                                 | Kenya; South Africa; Tanzania                                   | Daily oral TDFI FTC                                            | Trial discontinued for futility in April 2011.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Adherence assessment with monthly clinical samples to measure drug concentration is pending:                                            |
| VOICE MTN-003 | 5,029 heterosexual women aged 18-45 in high- prevalence areas                                                                 | Uganda; South                                                   | Daily oral TDF or daily oral TDFI FTC or daily topical TFV gel | No study drug significantly reduced the risk of HIV acquisition: Estimates of effectiveness were less than 0 for TDF and TDFI FTC daily oral (negative 48.8% and negative 4.2% TDFIFTC respectively) , and reduced risk of HIV infection of 14.7% for TDF gel. dosing | Adherence to study drugs was TFV was detected in 30% of the oral TDF arm, 29% in the oral TDFIFTC arm, and 25% in the TDF gel arm. low; |

to Acronyms: FTC = emtricitabine; TDF = tenofovir disoproxil fumarate; TFV = tenofovir

Key

Source: Adapted from: Kashuba et al., Pre-exposure prophylaxis for HIV prevention: how to predict success: Table Antiretroviral-based HIV prevention studies. Lancet. 2012,379(9835): 2409-2411.
